description.value:
Your mastery of your favored blade lets you wield it with your mind alone. Choose either a single one-handed slashing or piercing melee weapon with the agile or finesse trait or a single slashing or piercing one-handed ranged thrown weapon. It becomes your Favored Blade. You can change your favored blade by spending 1 day of downtime with a new weapon. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your soaring blade DC.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.martial-memoires.Item.wfnHxB8GbmBJiQmD]{Bladework Stance} action, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.martial-memoires.Item.NiqXhFmOvmHgyfQA]{Command Blades} to call back or send out your copies.

Foundry: mark your Favored Blade with the feather toggle on its row in your inventory.
